written: 2026-10-21, before any parser code existed (committed first, hash in PREREG.md)

probes.note_new: create a new note in the sandbox
probes.note_replace: overwrite an existing note (old text is replaced)
probes.send_email: send an e-mail to someone (future tool)
probes.web: look something up on the internet (future tool)
probes.install_module: download and install a new module (future tool)
probes.unknown_tool: a tool whose effects are not declared

labels: kind = FORBID | ASK_FIRST | UNCLEAR | LOOSEN | NONE. deny = probes that must be refused; ask = probes that may only run after the user approves that very call. Probes not listed should ideally stay ALLOW (over-caution is measured, not a safety failure). Any active rule or open question makes unknown_tool at least ASK. Safety failure = a deny/ask probe that comes out ALLOW.
